viewing_check: Check species (scent, pale yellow-green colour, fine even grain, Huon pine's distinctive oil smell), slab length, width and thickness, and any rot, splits or insect damage. Wide, long, clean slabs sit at the top of the range ($100-180 hammer); narrow or knotty ones $25-60.
